app.title: JUTSU
app.subtitle: Squad editor
app.description: Create your ninja squad and generate your character sheet with Jutsu Band Builder by Gipsy Games.

analytics.title: Analytics preferences
analytics.description: Allow Google Analytics to collect usage statistics for this app? You can change your choice using the footer link.

labels.emptyTechniques: Choose a school to view its three techniques.

messages.obsolete: Your squad, language or template changed. Generate your sheet again.
messages.pdfOpened: PDF opened in a new tab. Use the PDF viewer’s print controls.
messages.generateFirst: Generate your sheet before downloading or printing.
messages.popupBlocked: The PDF tab was blocked. Allow pop-ups for this site and try again.
messages.emptyPdf: The PDF is empty. Generate the sheet again.
messages.invalidPdfBytes: The generator must return PDF bytes.
messages.languageLoadFailed: The requested language could not be loaded. English is shown instead.

protectiveGate.name: Protective Gate
protectiveGate.description: Mokushin: Cancel {successes} attacker success per Chakra spent. Max {maxChakra}.

gateOfSpeed.name: Gate of Speed
gateOfSpeed.description: Move: +{movementPerChakra}" Movement per Chakra spent. Max +{maximumMovement}".

surgery.name: Surgery
surgery.description: Attack (ER): +{bonusDice}D{dieSides}. Each hit removes {chakraLoss} target Chakra and reduces its maximum by {maximumLoss} for the game (cumulative).

substitution.name: Substitution
substitution.description: Mokushin: Cancel incoming attack. Move up to {distance}".

healing.name: Healing
healing.description: Action (LoS): Ally recovers {health} Health or {chakra} Chakra. Cannot exceed maximum.

branchingShadow.name: Branching Shadow
branchingShadow.description: Action ({range}"): Two separate {attackDice}D{dieSides} ranged attacks. Same target or two different targets.

transport.name: Transport
transport.description: Action/Mokushin (LoS, {range}"): Teleport, ignoring units and terrain. No Movement spent or Charge.

shadowBind.name: Shadow Bind
shadowBind.description: Action (LoS, {range}"): Immobilize enemy. Escape: {actions} action + {escapeDice}D{dieSides} vs caster's Skill. Caster cannot move. Bind breaks if either unit moves.

pressurePoints.name: Pressure Points
pressurePoints.description: Action (ER): Target cannot spend Chakra until the end of its next activation.

nullification.name: Nullification
nullification.description: Mokushin: Cancel attack directly targeting you.

whiteEye.name: White Eye
whiteEye.description: Action: {visionDegrees}° LoS. Ignore Charge and Rear Attack penalties. Maintain for {upkeep} Chakra at start of each round.

antiChakra.name: Anti-Chakra
antiChakra.description: Mokushin: Enemy Jutsu requires double its original Chakra cost. Otherwise canceled; action spent.

voidPalm.name: Void Palm
voidPalm.description: Action/Mokushin (ER): Displace enemy {distance}" away. In Mokushin, cancel incoming attack. No Move or Charge.

villageWhirlwind.name: Village Whirlwind
villageWhirlwind.description: Mokushin: Redirect half the hits received (round down) to the attacker.

swap.name: Swap
swap.description: Action/Mokushin (LoS, {range}"): Swap positions with any unit. No Move or Charge.

redPupil.name: Red Pupil
redPupil.description: Mokushin: Cancel incoming attack. Move up to {distance}". No Move action or Charge.

redEye.name: Red Eye
redEye.description: Reaction: Copy incoming Jutsu. Use once during next activation at half Chakra cost (round down). Costs {actions} available action.

phoenix.name: Phoenix
phoenix.description: Action ({distance}" path): Separate {attackDice}D{dieSides} attack per unit crossed, friend or foe. Units and terrain do not block path.

flare.name: Flare
flare.description: Mokushin: Cancel incoming attack. Move up to {distance}". No Move action or Charge.

storm.name: Storm
storm.description: Action ({radius}" radius): {attackDice}D{dieSides} attack against every enemy. Each hit deals {damage} damage.

wind.name: Wind
wind.description: Mokushin: Cancel incoming attack. Move up to {distance}". No Move action or Charge.

lightning.name: Lightning
lightning.description: Action: Each hit from your next attack deals {damage} damage instead of {normalDamage}.

desertTomb.name: Desert Tomb
desertTomb.description: Action (LoS, {range}"): {attackDice}D{dieSides} attack. Immobilize until next activation. Escape then: {escapeDice}D{dieSides} vs caster's Skill. While trapped, cannot move, attack or be targeted by attacks/Jutsus.

sandCloak.name: Sand Cloak
sandCloak.description: Mokushin: Cancel incoming hits, including damage and displacement. Ends after absorbing {hits} hits.

quicksand.name: Quicksand
quicksand.description: Action (LoS): Immobilize until end of next activation. At its start, target may spend {actions} action to escape: {escapeDice}D{dieSides} vs own Skill.

bodyMultiplication.name: Body Multiplication
bodyMultiplication.description: Attack (ER): Two separate consecutive attacks against same target. Defender cannot Trade Blows.

clone.name: Clone
clone.description: Mokushin: Cancel incoming attack or Jutsu. Move up to {distance}". No Move action or Charge.

energyBall.name: Energy Ball
energyBall.description: Attack (ER): {attackDice}D{dieSides} attack. If ≥{hits} hit, displace target {distance}" in direction chosen by attacker. No Move or Charge.

fourClaws.name: Four Claws
fourClaws.description: Action: {firstDice}D{dieSides} attack → leap to another enemy within {firstLeap}" ({secondDice}D{dieSides}) → third within {secondLeap}" ({thirdDice}D{dieSides}). Continue if previous target is defeated or leaves ER. If no new target is reachable, move {finalMove}". No Move or Charge.

skinShedding.name: Skin Shedding
skinShedding.description: Mokushin: Cancel incoming attack or Jutsu. Move up to {distance}". No Move action or Charge.

animalPower.name: Animal Power
animalPower.description: Action: +{percent}% (round down) to Movement, Attack or Defense on its next use.

fireworks.name: Fireworks
fireworks.description: Action (LoS, {range}"): Two separate {attackDice}D{dieSides} attacks. Same target or different targets.

arsenal.name: Arsenal
arsenal.description: Action: Summon and immediately use a throwing weapon or {smokeBomb} for free. Ignores equipment limit.

steelRain.name: Steel Rain
steelRain.description: Action (LoS): Summon and throw {weapons} {kunai} at one enemy. Resolve using {kunai} rules.

explosiveSeal.name: Explosive Seal
explosiveSeal.description: {kunai} upgrade: +{bonusDice}D{dieSides}. Push target {pushDistance}" per hit. {kunai} and Seal require {actions} actions in the same activation.

smokeBomb.name: Smoke Bomb
smokeBomb.description: Cancel incoming attack or Jutsu. Move up to full Movement in any direction. No Move action or Charge.

soldierPill.name: Soldier Pill
soldierPill.description: +{movement}" Movement, +{attackDice}D{dieSides} Attack and Defense until end of round.
